The fresh expanded 9-file downstream case retains seven failed Documents with zero Evidence/Relation/SearchUnit/adapter Evidence, good XLSX partial, text neighbor success, and unchanged synthetic source hashes. These passes do not override the new terminal-dot failures below.

The unchanged prior https://invalid.example/worksheet.xml lookalike counterexample now rejects before Evidence/Relation output. The resolver checks first-segment colon, raw authority/double slash, query/fragment, controls, trailing slash and selected escape aliases before POSIX lookup. Permanent crafted lookalike ZIP-member cases freshly pass. This closes the exact prior absolute-URI counterexample but does not establish rejection of all equivalent directory-reference forms.

Source lines 4120-4136 validate the exact worksheet root and exactly one direct canonical sheetData for every resolved worksheet before the first workbook Evidence emission. The unchanged prior valid-first/invalid-second counterexample now passes with empty direct Reader Evidence/Relations. The permanent late missing/nested/foreign/duplicate sheetData cases also pass. Projection still processes one worksheet tree at a time. This closes F10-A06 for binding/sheetData defects; arbitrary later cell/style/media exceptions and full transactional Reader behavior remain outside this check.

A remaining variant of F10-A05 is independently reproduced: Target=worksheets/sheet1.xml/. or worksheets/sheet1.xml/child/.. binds the existing xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml, and equivalent xl/workbook.xml/. or xl/workbook.xml/child/.. root targets bind the workbook. All four subcases fail because ValueError is not raised. The raw trailing slash guard at parser line 656 does not detect a terminal dot segment; posixpath.normpath at line 675 removes the directory-ending meaning and yields a file part. A separate pure urllib.parse.urljoin computation preserves a final slash for these references, establishing the ambiguity without network access. This bypasses the same whole-part condition already enforced for a literal trailing slash. Reproducer: design/local-memory-v1-hardening/runs/f10-adversarial-dot-cases.v1.py, SHA-256 90315824ca74f4300b4c4b000e6406b527ea4435512c939ebdfcf22f2ef12f25. checks.required_action: Preserve the directory-ending URI meaning through dot-segment resolution or reject terminal '.' and '..' path segments before POSIX member lookup. Apply it to both package-root and worksheet references. Add permanent tests with existing file parts for '/.' and '/child/..', keep ordinary nonterminal dot-segment and valid package-absolute/relative paths working, rerun the unchanged original and new auditor cases plus scoped regressions, and submit a new immutable artifact for repair round 2 of maximum 2.

checks.reason: The shared caller inventory confirms that target rejection affects package roots, DOCX styles/sections/comments, PPTX slide/notes bindings, and media/chart/diagram traversal. Permanent pure-resolution cases freshly cover conventional XLSX/DOCX/PPTX relative and absolute paths and literal selected percent escapes. Independent real XLSX controls additionally pass './worksheets/sheet1.xml', 'worksheets/../worksheets/sheet1.xml', '/xl/./worksheets/sheet1.xml', and './part:name.xml', preserving values and original fixture hashes. No new full native DOCX/PPTX or hyperlink/fragment semantics are certified. Query/fragment references and percent/Unicode equivalence remain the declared unsupported whole-part subset; compatibility passes apply only to the demonstrated forms.

The decision remains revise at repair round 1, now for one reproducible URI-binding defect. The exact earlier two counterexamples are resolved, prior failures remain preserved, and no test count or structural-validator result is used to claim full XLSX/OPC support, model readiness, safe-index/answer acceptance, packaging readiness or product completion. One permitted repair cycle remains. Auditor writes are limited to f10-audit/f10-adversarial artifacts and generated repository scratch.
